sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (GOV.UK)
sources.title: Hydrogen transport and storage cost report
sources.locator_read: p10 (definitions and HHV statement); p21 (storage levelised costs and cycle rates); p29 (pipeline transport); p36-38 (annex tables)
sources.verbatim_quote: Using the Higher Heating Value (HHV) to express kWh, the energy content of 1kg of hydrogen is 39.4 kWh.
sources.second_quote: In this report, the levelised costs of hydrogen transport and storage are presented as £/kg.
sources.supports: R3-19, R3-26: the 39.4 kWh/kg HHV energy content that the brief's £9.5/kg derivation depends on, and the statement that transport/storage costs are £/kg levelised
sources.notes: Published 14 December 2023. The report itself warns that transport £/kg figures apply only to a specific, often unstated, distance (p8, p21).

sources.publisher: Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy / DESNZ (GOV.UK)
sources.title: Hydrogen Production Costs 2021
sources.locator_read: p16 'Capital expenditure (CAPEX)' - cost scope by technology
sources.verbatim_quote: For electrolysis, CAPEX covers the electrolyser system (the stack), all necessary balance of plant

sources.supports: R3-09, R3-13, R3-31: the installed-cost scope boundary (stack + BoP + civils + grid connection, excluding hydrogen compression), which is what makes the BEIS figure comparable with, and distinct from, the ITM list price

sources.title: Hydrogen Production Costs 2021 annex: Key assumptions and outputs for production technologies (XLSX)
sources.locator_read: Sheet 'Technical and cost assumptions', PEM block (columns for 2020 and 2025), rows 3-27: commissioning year, electrical conversion efficiency, operating lifetime, CAPEX '£/kW H2 HHV', fixed OPEX '£/KW H2 HHV/year', variable OPEX '£/KWh H2 HHV', hurdle rate. Also sheet '2020_E' rows 2-12 for LCOH components
sources.supports: R3-09, R3-10, R3-11, R3-14, R3-15, R3-17, R3-34: PEM 2020 medium efficiency 1.397 kWh_e/kWh H2 HHV, CAPEX 953.59/1158.63/1887.51 £/kW H2 HHV (low/medium/high), fixed OPEX 36.72 £/kW/yr, variable OPEX 0.0039 £/kWh, 30-year life, 10% hurdle, and the 2025 projection 730.29 £/kW H2 HHV at 1.3208
sources.notes: The shared document pipeline failed this XLSX with a memory-budget error; it was parsed with openpyxl in read-only mode instead, so cell values are as stored. The unit row is the important finding: CAPEX is per kW of H2 output (HHV), not per kW of electrical input.
